Name: Hellcycle
Author: MasterAki
Description:
The comes with new audio, skins for both the horse and stable.
(Note that the horse skin will affect the color of the stables).

[b]This mod contains:[/b]
[s]- 1 new audio[/s]
- 4 horse skin (original, blue, green and iridium)
- 4 stable sprite (original, blue, green and iridium)

[b]Plans for the future:
[/b]-More skins for motorcycle and stables.....
-Update the current sprites....
-Maybe a Fashion Sense based on Marvel/DC characters.....

[b]Known issue:[/b]

[b]-Custom Sound for the horse is not working.

[/b]Solution: Open in a text editor [CM] Hellcycle audio > content.json

"Music": [
        {
            "Id": "thudStep",
            "File": "hellcycleaudio.wav",
            "Preload": true,
            "Loop": false,
            "Conditions": "LC Game1.player.isRidingHorse() and string.find(Game1.player.mount.Name,'Horse') ~= nil",
        }
This is what it looks like. There should be three of them, just replace the [b]Horse[/b] with your[b] Horse name[/b] in your save.
